form.label: BigFix Security & Governance
form.description: Comprehensive audit trail for BigFix operator actions, logins, and configurations.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:audit" "LOGIN" | rex field=_raw "^(?<format_version>[^\|]*)\|(?<timestamp>[^\|]*)\|(?<message_priority>[^\|]*)\|(?<username>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_source>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_label>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_type>[^\|]*)\|(?<ip_address>[^\|]*)\|(?<message>.*)$" | search event_type="LOGIN" AND username!="SYSTEM" AND username!="" AND username="$tok_operator$" | timechart count by event_source

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:audit" ("failed" OR message_priority="ERROR") | rex field=_raw "^(?<format_version>[^\|]*)\|(?<timestamp>[^\|]*)\|(?<message_priority>[^\|]*)\|(?<username>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_source>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_label>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_type>[^\|]*)\|(?<ip_address>[^\|]*)\|(?<message>.*)$" | search username="$tok_operator$" | stats count by username, ip_address, message | rename username AS Operator, ip_address AS "IP Address", message AS "Error Details", count AS "Failures" | sort - Failures

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:audit" ("FIXLET" OR "TASK" OR "fixlet" OR "task") "CREATE" | rex field=_raw "^(?<format_version>[^\|]*)\|(?<timestamp>[^\|]*)\|(?<message_priority>[^\|]*)\|(?<username>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_source>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_label>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_type>[^\|]*)\|(?<ip_address>[^\|]*)\|(?<message>.*)$" | search event_label IN ("FIXLET", "TASK", "fixlet", "task") event_type="CREATE" username!="SYSTEM" AND username!="" AND username="$tok_operator$" | stats count by username | sort - count

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:audit" "COMPUTER" "DELETE" | rex field=_raw "^(?<format_version>[^\|]*)\|(?<timestamp>[^\|]*)\|(?<message_priority>[^\|]*)\|(?<username>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_source>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_label>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_type>[^\|]*)\|(?<ip_address>[^\|]*)\|(?<message>.*)$" | search event_label="COMPUTER" event_type="DELETE" username!="SYSTEM" AND username!="" AND username="$tok_operator$" | stats count by username, message | rename username AS Operator, message AS "Deletion Details", count AS "Total Deleted" | sort - "Total Deleted"

panel.title: Administrative Changes Audit Trail (Roles, Sites, Settings & Users)

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:root:audit" ("USER" OR "ROLE" OR "SETTING" OR "SITE") ("CREATE" OR "UPDATE" OR "DELETE") | rex field=_raw "^(?<format_version>[^\|]*)\|(?<timestamp>[^\|]*)\|(?<message_priority>[^\|]*)\|(?<username>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_source>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_label>[^\|]*)\|(?<event_type>[^\|]*)\|(?<ip_address>[^\|]*)\|(?<message>.*)$" | search event_label IN ("USER", "ROLE", "SETTING", "SITE") event_type IN ("CREATE", "UPDATE", "DELETE") username!="SYSTEM" AND username!="" AND username="$tok_operator$" | table timestamp, username, event_type, event_label, message | rename timestamp AS Timestamp, username AS Operator, event_type AS Action, event_label AS "System Component", message AS Details | sort - Timestamp
